tabs.heading: How It Works
tabs.html:
Pull the pin and the Grenade Chew Toy turns on. It then rolls around on its own, bouncing and changing direction, so your pup has a target to chase even when you're busy. The glowing ring makes it easy for them to track.

When the battery runs low, plug it in over USB-C and it's ready for the next mission.

products.description_html:
Meet the Grenade Chew Toy: the self-rolling grenade that plays back. 💣

Pull the pin and it switches on. Then it rolls around on its own, bouncing and changing direction so your dog always has a new target to chase. A glowing ring keeps their attention locked on the mission, and when the battery runs low you just plug it in with USB-C and it's ready for the next round.

💣 Pull the pin to turn it on
🎯 Rolls around and bounces by itself
🔋 USB-C rechargeable, no batteries needed
💧 Rinse it off under water after the mission

Built for supervised play, not heavy chewing. Pick it up when the mission is over.

reviews.author: Jessica R.
reviews.text: My border collie destroys EVERYTHING and gets bored so fast, so I’m always looking for toys that actually keep him engaged. We got the RuffMission Grenade Toy and I honestly didn’t expect him to love it this much. The fact that it moves on its own is what makes it different — he goes crazy chasing it around the house. The unpredictable movement keeps him locked in, and the interactive design makes it way more exciting than a regular chew toy. He’s completely obsessed. 😂

reviews.author: Sarah M.
reviews.text: High-energy dog + working from home = total chaos. This interactive grenade toy has honestly been a lifesaver. My dog loves that it moves by itself, so he can stay busy chasing, pouncing, and playing with it without me constantly having to entertain him. It keeps him engaged way longer than normal toys, and he never seems to get bored because it’s always doing something. Such a fun idea, and the tactical design makes it even better. 🪦🐾

reviews.author: Luna R.
reviews.text: We’ve tried so many dog toys and most of them get ignored after a day or two. The RuffMission Grenade Toy is different because it’s actually interactive and moves on its own, which instantly grabs my dog’s attention. My German Shepherd loves chasing it when it starts rolling around, and then he’ll grab it and carry it off like he won a prize. 😂 It’s one of the few toys that keeps him entertained without me having to do much. Definitely one of our best pet purchases.
